## Overview

I have contributed five Nextflow modules to the [nf-core](https://nf-co.re/) community collection for analyzing copy number trajectories from genomic sequencing data. These modules implement the core steps of the coptr workflow, enabling reproducible, containerized analysis of copy number variation dynamics.

## Contributed Modules

### 1. [coptr_index](https://nf-co.re/modules/coptr_index/)
Prepares reference genome index files for coptr analysis.

### 2. [coptr_map](https://nf-co.re/modules/coptr_map/)
Maps sequencing reads to the reference genome and generates BAM files for downstream analysis.

### 3. [coptr_extract](https://nf-co.re/modules/coptr_extract/)
Extracts copy number information from BAM files and prepares data for trajectory analysis.

### 4. [coptr_estimate](https://nf-co.re/modules/coptr_estimate/)
Estimates copy number trajectories using statistical methods to infer temporal dynamics.

### 5. [coptr_merge](https://nf-co.re/modules/coptr_merge/)
Merges and consolidates results from multiple samples for comparative analysis.

## About coptr

Copy number trajectory (coptr) analysis is a computational approach for studying copy number variation dynamics in genomic samples. This is particularly useful in cancer genomics, microbial evolution, and other contexts where understanding temporal or population-level changes in copy number is important.

## Key Features

- **nf-core Standard**: All modules follow [nf-core best practices](https://nf-co.re/developers/module_guidelines) for consistency and reproducibility
- **Containerized**: Each module includes Docker and Singularity container definitions
- **Tested**: Modules include comprehensive test data and assertions
- **Documented**: Full documentation and parameter descriptions in each module

## Integration

These modules are designed to be used individually or as part of a larger Nextflow pipeline. They can be included in any DSL2 workflow using:

```groovy
include { COPTR_INDEX; COPTR_MAP; COPTR_EXTRACT; COPTR_ESTIMATE; COPTR_MERGE } from 'modules/nf-core/coptr'
```
